rationale: The v2 evidence and working evaluation rule out competing as another declaration workspace but leave a narrower, unvalidated interoperability hypothesis. Version 4 therefore shifts the control point to the permissioned handoff into systems brands already use, removes legal determinations and declaration generation, makes the converter the sole initial payer, funds connector work through implementation milestones, and ties recurring revenue to maintained evidence mappings and acknowledged changes. This is a genuine architecture and economics change, while all incumbent overlap, access, permission, pricing, reuse, margin, workload, conflict, and adoption uncertainties remain explicit.
